transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I... well, I'm here because of an ongoing issue at work. I do translation work, and... for months now, I've been seeing the same pattern in the project files. 

It's just... certain subcontractors and one colleague in particular. They keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory. And the timestamps. It's done so it looks like my quality control failed. I've brought it up, and even when IT says the audit trail is clean... I know what I'm looking at. The record has been arranged to put the blame on me. 

That's... that's really all it is. I'm not sure why I needed to come here for it.
Do you believe other people around you share this same concern about being deliberately framed at work?
I haven't... really asked anyone. I don't think so. It seems like it's just my files they're focusing on. I mostly just keep to myself.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people around you could not?

No. I... no. I'm not seeing things, if that's what you're asking. 

It's just the files on my computer. I don't... I don't have that kind of problem.
How certain are you that your colleague is deliberately changing the files to frame you?

I'm... very certain. 

Like I said, I know what I'm looking at in those project files. IT can say the audit trail is clean all they want, but... I know my own work. I know the record has been arranged to put the blame on me. 

I wouldn't have brought it up if I wasn't sure.
Do you think the people changing the files can read your mind or know your thoughts?

No. I... no. That's not what's happening. 

They just have access to the system. Nobody is reading my mind. I don't even know why you would ask that.
Have you ever had any hallucinations, meaning hearing, seeing, or sensing things that other people could not?

Didn't you... didn't you just ask me that? 

No. I don't... I don't see or hear things. I'm not sensing anything that isn't there. Like I said before, it's just the computer files. That's all.
Have you become more socially withdrawn or had trouble showing emotion or interest in things you used to enjoy?
No, not really. I mean, I still do the things I usually do. I'm just... dealing with this situation at work. That's all it is.
Outside of the files at work, do you have similar beliefs that other people are trying to target, monitor, or harm you?

No. I... no. Outside of this issue with the project, everything is normal. I still do my translation work, manage my team's workflow... pay my bills, keep up with my family routine. 

It's just regular life. The only place things really go off track is when the file history or... certain coworkers come up. That's it. Nobody is targeting me outside of that.
Have you generally been suspicious of other people and felt they might be out to use or harm you for most of your adult life?

No. I... no. I've never had a problem with people before this. I don't really... I don't go around thinking people are out to get me. I've always gotten along fine with everyone until this specific thing started happening.
Have you noticed any unusual changes in the way you think or speak, such as your thoughts feeling jumbled or other people saying your speech is hard to follow?
No. My thoughts are fine. I speak for a living, so... no, nobody has said anything like that. My speech is perfectly normal.
How long have you been certain that your coworker is deliberately framing you with these file changes?
It's been... about 11 months. Yeah, 11 months. It started not long after they put me in charge of the new localization project.
Have you noticed any changes in how clearly you think or speak, like your thoughts becoming jumbled or hard for other people to follow?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said, my thinking is fine. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs that others told you were not true?
No. I don't... I don't have "unusual beliefs." People don't say things like that to me. It's just what I've seen happening with my files at work. That's all.
Have you ever had any other fixed beliefs that other people found strange or that turned out not to be true?
I think... I think you just asked me that, too. No. I haven't. Just the issue with my coworker. That's it.
Have you noticed any lack of motivation or loss of interest in things you used to enjoy?
No. I... I still go to work, I still do what I need to do. I haven't lost interest in anything.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was around?
No. I don't... I don't hear things like that. If no one is around, it's just quiet.
Have you ever believed that someone was controlling your thoughts or actions?
No. I... no. My thoughts are mine. Nobody is controlling what I do.
Has this belief ever spread to other parts of your life, or is it only about the files and coworkers at work?

No, it's... it's just work. Outside of that, everything is fine. I still do my translations, manage the workflow for the team, pay my bills... spend time with my family. Normal things. It's really just... when I have to deal with the file history, or those specific people at the office. That's the only time there's an issue. Everything else is normal.
Have you noticed any reduced emotional expression, like seeming less able to show feelings than you used to?
No. I haven't noticed anything like that. I feel... fine. Just like I always do.
Have other people ever told you that your speech or thoughts were hard to follow or seemed disorganized?
No. I... no. People understand me fine. I communicate for a living, so... no, no one has ever said that to me.
